scope: HostRenderer binds the canonical native SceneHostView to authenticated ownership, physical extent, DPI, injected font resources, Surface generations, suspend/resume/retire, a host-owned software target, and a host-owned wgpu TextureView present boundary.

api.surface_generation: initial generation is active; successful resize/DPI reconfigure, suspend, and resume each produce a strictly newer generation
render_entry: render_to_surface(owner, version, generation, bytes, stride, budget)
render_gpu_to_host_view(owner, version, generation, gpu, format, view, budget)
api.gpu_present_ack: gpu_presented(owner, generation) succeeds only after the host's Queue::present succeeds; the frame remains pending before acknowledgement
api.rejection: foreign owner, stale generation, suspended/retired state, zero extent, invalid DPI, generation exhaustion and unsupported GPU format fail closed

covers: injected font resource install, borrow and stale-generation release
invalid and empty font stacks fail before view construction
same-extent DPI reconfigure invalidates the old host pixel copy
suspend with retained scene state and suspended render rejection
resume with new generation and repaint
backend present failure keeps the view dirty for retry
host-created wgpu instance, adapter, device, queue and texture
direct TextureView rendering and exact pixel readback
present acknowledgement keeps needs_frame true until host confirmation
unsupported RGBA16Float fails closed without acknowledging presentation

third_party_tcb: X11/Xvfb/softbuffer and the platform display stack

limitations: The Xvfb Surface is a real X11 protocol endpoint but not a compositor, hardware display controller, vsync source, or hardware swapchain.
llvmpipe Vulkan validates the adapter path but not hardware GPU or device-loss recovery.
The supported suspend/resume contract is exercised at the native-host state boundary; platform session-manager delivery is not available.
The engine checks the requested TextureView extent and format but cannot introspect the host texture creation descriptor.
HostRenderer composition over Blitz/wgpu and all third-party Surface behavior do not yet have the full ordered implementation proof.
The full CPU all-target run is not claimed complete: native_cpu_acceptance requires the exact Noto CJK fixture whose pinned metrics differ from the available Droid fallback.
The capability matrix is a compile contract, not a claim that jasper-os provides these resources.

handoff_to_claude.reason: The finite surface-generation machine is suitable for Kani/Miri, while Blitz, Vello and wgpu object lineage require a larger explicit TCB or an extractable orchestration model.
